matrix.interpretation: Compare the price movements of peer roles 1, 3 and 5 in the same proposed normal impulse. 3 may not be strictly smaller than both; 3 need not be largest.
matrix.operands: Authoritative comparable movements for roles 1/3/5, not every visible subwave.
matrix.boundary_cases: Strict shortest fails; middle or largest does not violate this proposition on a settled basis. Ties require separate resolution.

matrix.interpretation: The seminar says shorter than both, and examples use strict inequalities. The strict predicate excludes ties, but treating it as an exhaustive pass/fail definition is an additional assumption. The book gives a greater-than sufficient condition, not an explicit tied-shortest adjudication.
matrix.operands: Comparable L1,L3,L5 on an agreed basis.
matrix.boundary_cases: L3=L1<L5; L3=L5<L1; all equal remain frozen. About equal on page 32 is not exact equality.
matrix.unresolved_dependencies: Explicit equality boundary authority; P004 equality cannot be imported.

matrix.interpretation: The seminar requires both arithmetic and percentage; the book says percentage exceeding either comparator suffices while arithmetic holds almost always.
matrix.operands: Separate arithmetic and percentage comparison results.
matrix.boundary_cases: Percentage non-shortest / arithmetic strictly shortest has incompatible policy outcomes. Agreement does not authorize ignoring the conflict globally.
matrix.unresolved_dependencies: Source-policy-authorized resolution; no automatic preference for book or video.

matrix.interpretation: P005 names price movement. Elapsed duration, slope, chart-pixel distance, volume and accumulated tick activity are not substitutes.
matrix.boundary_cases: Time and price can order waves differently. Equality in time elsewhere is only a guideline.
matrix.unresolved_dependencies: Exact arithmetic/percentage operations still need agreement.

matrix.interpretation: Subtraction of labeled prices is explicit in an upward diagonal example. Its translation to an absolute or direction-normalized displacement for arbitrary normal impulses is a proposed mathematical representation, not newly locked methodology.
matrix.operands: s_i,e_i: exact labeled start/end price values; d: explicit direction if normalization proposed.
matrix.boundary_cases: Negative prices, opposite-direction pairs, zero movement and mixed units cannot be silently normalized into usable waves.
matrix.unresolved_dependencies: Universal P005 metric policy and exact observation contract.

matrix.interpretation: Book examples use percentage gains and distinguish chart projection from exactly equivalent gain. A starting-price denominator and simple return are plausible candidate formulas; no P005-specific universal denominator, negative/zero-price convention, or loss/magnitude operation is specified. Log chart scale is not itself a rule to compute P005 with log returns.
matrix.operands: s_i,e_i with declared measurement basis and domain.
matrix.boundary_cases: Zero denominator, negative starting value, downward percentage and simple-vs-log disagreement are not assigned methodology outcomes.
matrix.unresolved_dependencies: Metric definition and its valid price domain; dual-basis policy conflict.

matrix.interpretation: Descending C example and book bull/bear drawings apply the structure in both directions. An exact signed/absolute numerical mapping is a proposed derivation; literal signed changes would wrongly equate more-negative with shorter.
matrix.operands: Explicit proposed direction and exact same-role boundaries.
matrix.boundary_cases: Upward and downward mirror geometry; percentages need not be invariant under additive price reflection.
matrix.unresolved_dependencies: No automatic pivot-kind or timeframe inference of direction; unresolved universal formula.

matrix.interpretation: Labeled origin/end roles are supported, and orthodox end can differ from a whole-pattern extreme. Typical chapter-4 orthodox measurement is not a universal P005 requirement. No source establishes that any geometric pivot, close, intrabar high/low, accumulated path travel or whole-wave extreme may always substitute.
matrix.operands: Proposed endpoint pair plus candidate/binding/role identity and price-basis provenance.
matrix.boundary_cases: Intrawave extreme differs from terminal pivot; truncation makes parent extreme differ from termination; substituted equivalent-value identities are not authority.
matrix.unresolved_dependencies: Exact P005 operands and conditional-hypothesis applicability; observation transport alone does not resolve source semantics.

matrix.interpretation: A still-developing 5 can invalidate the drawn fixed labeling once longer than 3 while 1 already exceeds 3. Completion of 5 is not universally necessary to observe such a contradiction.
matrix.operands: Established role1/3 measurements, current role5 displacement and fixed candidate ancestry.
matrix.boundary_cases: Strict crossing in the example; equality not decided. A movable endpoint that later retreats does not establish permanent invalidity without an authorized extremum/endpoint policy.
matrix.unresolved_dependencies: Irreversibility, exact active-wave observation transport, confirmed fixed operands and metric policy.

matrix.interpretation: For fixed trustworthy lengths, L3>L1 means L3 cannot be shortest regardless of L5 under that same basis. This algebra does not supply completion evidence or permission to issue a runtime status on mutable/developing measurements.
matrix.operands: Role identity, established measurement basis and endpoint/completion evidence.
matrix.boundary_cases: Developing L5 below threshold is not universal satisfaction; completed L5 with fixed lengths still does not confer family validity.
matrix.unresolved_dependencies: No source-defined deterministic completion/terminality engine; family registry empty and base-case blocker active.

matrix.interpretation: Extensions retain the three peer actionary roles; prominent subdivisions do not change comparison to every visible swing. Usual third-wave extension and suggested relabeling after failure are not mandatory recovery logic.
matrix.boundary_cases: Nine visible swings do not replace role1/3/5. About-equal 1 and3 followed by extended5 does not decide exact tie.
matrix.unresolved_dependencies: No auto-extension or relabeling; no additional invalidator.

matrix.interpretation: A fifth may terminate without passing third's terminal price, subject to its required structure. That does not mean L5 is zero or absent, and does not waive P005.
matrix.operands: Actual proposed fifth origin and ending, not third-to-fifth net difference.
matrix.boundary_cases: Bull/bear truncations; internal validity cannot be fabricated from price failure to exceed3.
matrix.unresolved_dependencies: Family/subdivision proof and orthodox endpoint authority remain unavailable.

matrix.interpretation: No P005-specific epsilon, tick allowance, rounding, approximate equality or minimum difference was found. Approximate relationships and gauge-imperfection warnings do not authorize numerical tolerance.
matrix.operands: Exact declared numeric representation, if future contract approved.
matrix.boundary_cases: Just below/above equality; rounding can turn strict shortest into a tie.
matrix.unresolved_dependencies: No tolerance may be invented. Numeric representation is a future explicit contract choice, not a remembered Elliott convention.

formula_candidates.applicability: Only fixed comparable lengths in one source-authorized basis; normal-impulse peer roles.
formula_candidates.unsupported_assumption: Making its logical complement a complete satisfaction rule would decide ties without explicit adjudication.

formula_candidates.applicability: Hypothetical alternate reading of shortest, for contrast only.
formula_candidates.unsupported_assumption: Treats tied minimum (including all equal) as prohibited; not established by an explicit source boundary. Not selected.

formula_candidates.formula: A_i = |e_i - s_i|, or A_i = d * (e_i - s_i) when d explicitly matches every actionary role.
formula_candidates.applicability: Fixed proposed start/end pairs in common units; second form requires direction-consistency checks.
formula_candidates.unsupported_assumption: Generalizing an upward diagonal point example to universal normal-impulse operands, path choice and downward treatment. This is not an approved P005 formula.

formula_candidates.applicability: Illustrative simple percentage on positive starting prices only.
formula_candidates.unsupported_assumption: P005 starting-price denominator, magnitude treatment and positive-only domain are not explicitly settled as a universal contract. End-price/common denominator alternatives are not adopted.

formula_candidates.formula: G_i = |log(e_i / s_i)|, for s_i > 0 and e_i > 0
formula_candidates.applicability: Mathematical candidate for semilog distance, not selected.
formula_candidates.unsupported_assumption: A recommendation for semilog charts is not P005 log-return authorization.

formula_candidates.formula: Video reading: reject when strict-shortest(A) OR strict-shortest(R). Book sufficient statement: R3 > R1 OR R3 > R5 establishes non-shortest regardless of arithmetic.
formula_candidates.unsupported_assumption: Choosing either as controlling source policy; neither selected.

current_contract_review.finding: Identity-repaired five-slot hypothesis retains exact generated candidate, binding, roles, selected pivots and P004 bounded request. It executes P004 only and exposes P005/P006 dependencies. These identities can support a future conditional input; they do not confer universal orthodox endpoint, percentage policy or completion authority.
